components.name: audit-log
components.flow_part: Writes a chained audit row of each operation in the transaction of the operation.

components.name: command
components.flow_part: Runs the declared command in the transaction of the caller's tenant.

components.name: domain-probe
components.flow_part: Runs the declared domain probes and reports what they observe.

components.name: jwt-auth
components.flow_part: Checks the token of the request and puts the caller's identity on it.

components.name: kafka-producer
components.flow_part: Publishes each change message of the outbox to Kafka.

components.name: otel-tracing
components.flow_part: Exports a trace span of each request to the OpenTelemetry collector.

components.name: outbox
components.flow_part: Writes each change message to the outbox in the transaction of the write.

components.name: postgres-adapter
components.flow_part: Reads and writes the rows of each entity in PostgreSQL in one transaction.

components.name: query
components.flow_part: Runs the declared query for the caller and gives back its rows.

components.name: rest-api
components.flow_part: Decodes the request of a collection operation and calls its command or query.

components.name: spicedb-authz
components.flow_part: Asks SpiceDB whether the caller holds the permission of the operation.

components.name: tenancy
components.flow_part: Checks that the caller's tenant is active and scopes the request to it.
